5725675.name: Cozyleigh Desk Ecosystem
5725675.description: Every piece in the Cozyleigh Ecosystem begins with a foundation — a surface that grounds your space and gives everything a home. The Pro Desk Mat anchors your desk. The Zen Tray, inspired by the Korean soban, brings that same sense of intention wherever you go. From there, magnetic accessories snap into place: a charger stand for your phone, a trinket tray for the small things that matter. Rooted in Asian craft and philosophy — from the calm of Japanese Zen gardens to the harmony of the gaiwan, from the portability of the Korean soban to the four-petal motifs of Chinese design — each piece is made not just to function, but to bring a quiet sense of order and beauty to your everyday rituals. Handcrafted in our little family studio, one piece at a time. Made with intention. Built to work together.

5725610.name: The Wood Collection
5725610.description: Our first wood collection. Designed by our family. Handcrafted in our studio.Each piece in this collection draws from centuries of Asian craft tradition — the Korean Soban philosophy that a personal surface should belong to you and travel with you, the Japanese torii gate as a structure that creates intention and threshold, the quiet craft of traditional joinery where the construction itself becomes the beauty.These are objects designed to move through your life with you. To create a sense of calm wherever they land — your desk, your nightstand, your kitchen counter, your coffee table. To hold the things that matter to you with a quiet sense of purpose.Solid maple, cherry, white oak, and walnut. Three-tone wood construction. Finished by hand with hardwax oil. A hidden magnetic layer built directly into every tray, integrating seamlessly with the Cozyleigh ecosystem.Made to order. Very limited quantities. Each piece handcrafted individually in our studio in New Jersey.
